title: Decoupled Marginal Sharpening for Training-Free Inference-Time Scaling
abstract: arXiv:2610.20483v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study how to improve LLM reasoning at inference time without updating model weights or using external reward models. Recent reward-free power-sampling methods define the sequence-level power target $\pi_\alpha(y\mid x)\propto p_0(y\mid x)^\alpha$, where $\alpha>1$, which increases the relative probability of completions that are already likely under the base model. Existing methods use Metropolis--Hastings or Sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) to approximately sample from this target. However, two challenges arise at different levels. At the target level, full-sequence sharpening can concentrate probability on a few exact reasoning--answer trajectories, suppressing alternative paths that support the same answer. At the sampler level, finite-particle SMC can suffer from path collapse when resampling repeatedly duplicates a few high-weight prefixes. translated_title: 面向免训练推理时扩展的解耦边际锐化
translated_abstract: 我们研究如何在推理阶段改进大语言模型（LLM）的推理能力，而无需更新模型权重或使用外部奖励模型。近期的无奖励幂采样方法定义了序列级幂目标 $\pi_\alpha(y\mid x)\propto p_0(y\mid x)^\alpha$，其中 $\alpha>1$，该目标提升了在基础模型下已经具有较高相对概率的补全的相对概率。现有方法使用 Metropolis--Hastings 或序贯蒙特卡洛（SMC）来近似地从该目标中采样。然而，在两个不同层面会出现挑战：在目标层面，全序列锐化可能将概率集中到少数精确的“推理--答案”轨迹上，从而抑制支持相同答案的其他备选推理路径；在采样器层面，有限粒子的 SMC 在重采样过程中反复复制少数高权重前缀时，可能出现路径坍缩。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了解耦边际锐化（Decoupled Marginal Sharpening, DMS），它分别在……（原文摘要到此截断）
tldr: 该论文提出解耦边际锐化（DMS），在目标层面和采样器层面分别进行锐化，以克服全序列锐化抑制多样推理路径以及有限粒子SMC路径坍缩的问题，从而实现无需训练和奖励模型的LLM推理时性能提升。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes Decoupled Marginal Sharpening (DMS), which addresses target-level over-sharpening of full sequences and sampler-level path collapse in finite-particle SMC separately, enabling training-free and reward-free inference-time scaling for LLM reasoning.
